sources: I-2003/01 art.2, COBAC Bulletin 6 printed p.187
conflicts.observed: 2003 article 2 list assigns 2651=private investment securities and 2652=public; 2003 commentary on same page describes 2651 as public fixed-income securities; 2015 art.3 explicitly subdivides 2651 as public and 2652 as private.
conflicts.decision: Do not resolve by arbitrary choice or overwrite history. Model instrument-versioned mappings and obtain formal authoritative clarification of 2003 internal discrepancy and institution-approved transition; current 2015 wording is an amendment candidate, not proof of full 2026 chart.
conflicts.effect: Incorrect government/private securities classification, prudential aggregation, collateral eligibility and financial statements.

conflicts.topic: I-2015/01 Article 8 apparent internal account-number error
conflicts.observed: Art.8(b) creates 321=short-term healthy and 322=short-term sensitive; art.8(d) names 312 short-term sensitive but all its listed child accounts start with 322.
conflicts.decision: Treat 312 reference as unresolved textual inconsistency, not silently auto-corrected; seek COBAC erratum or licensed-institution-approved mapping with legal review.
conflicts.effect: Potential cross-tenor GL misclassification between medium-term 312 and short-term 322.

sources: R-2018/01 art.33 and execution clause, printed p.12, image inspected
conflicts.observed: The scanned page reads 1er janvier 2018 as entry into force; document states decided 16 janvier 2018. PDF text extraction omits the superscript day, but page image resolves wording.
conflicts.decision: Record explicit stated date, signature date and separate legal-effect interpretation. Do not apply retrospective postings, provisioning releases or historical journal rewrites without qualified legal/institutional approval.
conflicts.effect: Financial restatement, audit and regulatory risk.

conflicts.observed: 2015 PCEC credit-classification commentary references R-2014/01; 2018 art.32 expressly abrogates contrary earlier provisions, notably R-2014/01.
conflicts.decision: Resolve precedence at the rule level; retain historical 2015 account structures separately from current classification decision authority. Never use 2014 definitions merely because 2015 PCEC commentary cites them.
conflicts.effect: Wrong risk staging/provisioning and report mapping.

conflicts.observed: Issuer annual report states I-2002/01 entered into force 1 July 2002; full authenticated instruction text was not obtained this run.
conflicts.decision: Record effective date as issuer-report historical claim, not substitute for original instrument or current 2026 mapping.

conflicts.topic: 2015 provision general reserve rule vs 2018 rule
conflicts.observed: 2015 PCEC article 2 and 2018 regulation articles 16–17 both address 0.5% annual general provisioning and 2% stock threshold; 2018 text explicitly states annual minimum ceases once 2% achieved, provided threshold is maintained.
conflicts.decision: No standalone threshold from the 2015 extract may be activated without reading the 2018 conditions and any later applicable rule, institutional policy, eligible base and accounting mappings.
